content:
tara: quick thread  proposal: simplify SDK-visible routing headers to a tiny stable surface and move richer policy/context into an internal-only header that only platform components add. aim: reduce churn for client libs and keep quota/console mapping stable. thoughts?

noah: agree on the goal. what are the exact header names you want to lock?

tara: thinking: `x-rw-hint` (stable k=v pairs), `x-rw-meta` (short csv attribs), `x-rw-hint-ver` (negotiation). internal-only: `x-rw-baggage` (json blob, platform-internal). SDKs must not emit baggage by default.

eric: console uses route -> model mapping and billing attribution. we need `x-rw-meta` to carry tenant and cost_center at minimum. otherwise dashboards break.

yuki: SDK implementation note: python/ts/go should parse `x-rw-hint` and `x-rw-meta` only by default. add an opt-in flag RW_SEND_BAGGAGE for Dedicated/Private customers that will allow SDKs to include `x-rw-baggage` (encoded). we'll keep parsing fallback for 2 releases.

ci-bot: canary deploy earlier today logged: `header_parser: unexpected end of input` when parsing baggage on edge proxy.

noah: that means proxies can truncate long headers. options: require base64 for baggage, or forbid client-public baggage and let platform attach it server-side. base64 adds CPU and size issues for telemetry ingestion.

eric: prefer forbidding client baggage. platform already has the context in many hops; it can enrich request on our internal mesh so console/quotas get the full policy. For public SDKs, keep `x-rw-hint` + `x-rw-meta`.

tara: decision leaning same. SDKs: v1 default only emits x-rw-hint/meta. v2 negotiates via x-rw-hint-ver and can opt into sending baggage when env is private. we'll publish migration guide.

yuki: action list: I will add unit tests for header parsing and a CLI flag to emulate platform enrichment. Also add sample code snippet for changelog.

noah: I can update quota reader to prefer `x-rw-meta.cost_center`, then fall back to parsing `x-rw-hint`. This reduces breakage risk.

ci-bot: staging canary scheduled tomorrow 04:00 UTC. previous failure noted: baggage JSON truncated at 1024 bytes in edge proxy.

eric: small note for docs: include exact header examples and the fallback rules. e.g.
```
x-rw-hint: tenant=acme,env=prod
x-rw-hint-ver: 1
x-rw-meta: cost_center=88,team=platform
x-rw-baggage: {"policy":"prefer-cheap","trace":"z7y"}  # internal only, added by platform
```

yuki: sample python snippet I'll add to SDK README:
```
# route_hint parsing
hint = header.get("x-rw-hint")
meta = parse_csv_kv(header.get("x-rw-meta"))
if env.is_dedicated and os.getenv("RW_SEND_BAGGAGE") == "1":
    baggage = maybe_json(header.get("x-rw-baggage"))
```

tara: timeline: RFC by Friday, 10 day opt-in canary, deprecation notice for public baggage in 10 weeks. We'll monitor console telemetry after canary. I'll create RFC and link back.

eric: thanks — please include a note to ops about header size limits on proxies.

noah: adding release note blurb and deprecation checklist now.

yuki: I'll open PRs in each SDK repo with compat code and tests.

tara: great, closing loop: SDKs send small stable headers, platform attaches rich context internally, forbid public baggage by default. RFC link inbound.
